why_it_matters.to: The work targets a practical bottleneck for agent builders: hand-crafted tool libraries are laborious to create and maintain and fail on new query types, so automatic tool generation could ease that labor.

rulings.claim: Automatic tool generation could lower the cost of maintaining tool libraries.
